plugins.name: tmux-pair
plugins.description: Coordinate one or more coding agents on a task via tmux + git worktrees. /run auto-recommends solo vs spawn from a quick repo + task recon. /solo runs a single agent with gated 6-phase self-review; /spawn runs a coordinated team of orchestrator + writers + reviewers (size 3..5 via --size, --parallel-writers for disjoint-bullet teams). Includes the orchestration script, the tmux-pair-orchestration skill, PROJECT.md care, scoped subagents for the gates, sender identity prefixes, explicit parallel-plan markers, auto-detection of repo-specific subagents (`.claude/agents/<repo>-*.md`) listed in every briefing, shipped rules templates for 7 stacks, bundled companion skills (gepa for prompt-optimization, dg for adversarial code review), and pi as third coding agent alongside claude + codex.
